6859.title: Superseded outline responses consume cache capacity
6859.rootCauseOneLine: The response LRU keys entries by outline revision without replacing the prior entry for the thread.
6859.proposedFix: Index the LRU by thread ID and store the current revision key with its items, replacing stale revisions while refreshing recency.
6859.caveats: No production heap or exact memory usage measured; both clean baseline runs used Linux and Node 22.
